name: Castle Keep & Courtyard
description: Great hall, guard rooms and a walled courtyard of heavy dressed stone.
palette: cold dressed granite, banner crimson, iron black, packed courtyard sand
lighting: hard daylight in the courtyard, torchlit gloom inside the keep
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: dressed granite flagstones with tight mortar joints, sand-strewn in the courtyard, worn hollow along the walking lines and dark with soot near the hearths
materials: A fantasy castle keep seen from above. Massive dressed granite walls two squares thick with arrow slits, a great hall open to the sky with a long timber table, benches and a raised dais, banners of plain undyed cloth spread flat along the tops of the walls with no lettering, iron braziers and wall torches, a guard room with weapon racks and a bunk, a spiral stair drawn as a stone drum with wedge-shaped treads, a walled courtyard of packed sand with a stone well, iron-bound doors, chains and a portcullis groove cut into the gate floor.
